note: Both sets capture the same four datum values from the two section level markers (grade level 0'-0" and finished floor 2'-9 1/2"), and both bind them to the kitchen/bedroom areas shown in the C1 and A1 sections. Set A's quotes each include the room name along with the level and value, so the entity binding is actually supported by the quoted text. Set B's two grade-level claims quote only the generic 'GRADE LEVEL 0'-0"' string, which does not support the Kitchen or Bedroom binding, and its 'relative to grade level' condition is an inference not stated on the sheet. Set A is therefore the more faithful set with no unsupported claims.
